observation: 'NO_ACTION' is only valid when Prometeo can prove that useful work is already advancing, an external dependency is durably owned with a resume condition, or no safe useful frontier exists. If active useful capacity is zero and useful work/rescue exists, telling the human to do nothing recreates the human bottleneck and can stall the project indefinitely.
decision: if active_useful_workers > 0 -> NO_ACTION may be valid
else if durable_owned_wait with resume condition -> NO_ACTION may be valid
else if safe_useful_frontier exhausted -> NO_ACTION may be valid

current_case.normal_universal_prompt_status: temporarily blocked until rescue closes or yields an owner-backed boundary

ui_rule: Primary Chat must never display NO_ACTION without also displaying the evidence class that justifies it: ACTIVE_MOTOR, OWNED_WAIT, or EXHAUSTED_FRONTIER.
